name: WikiTree
description: The provided code snippet is for a Vue.js component named `WikiSettings.vue`, which manages a wiki tree structure. The component imports another component called `WikiTree.vue` and provides functionalities to add, edit, and delete items from the wiki tree. It uses Vue's reactivity system to manage the state of selected items and interact with an API to fetch and save the wiki configuration through Vuex store actions. Additionally, the component template facilitates user interaction with buttons for saving and discarding changes, as well as item selection for detailed viewing and modification.
